items.title: ExxonMobil (XOM) Was Excluded From A White House Oil Meeting
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings (NYSE:XOM) was left out of a recent White House meeting of major oil executives on US gasoline prices, according to people familiar with the talks. The gathering focused on refinery capacity and retail fuel pricing, and the administration pressed attending companies on actions that could affect US drivers.
